◈ What is NTMPI?

NTMPI is the native token of the Neutaro blockchain, powering the Timpi decentralized search engine ecosystem. It's used for governance, validator staking, node rewards, and payments within the Timpi data marketplace.

The ERC-20 version of NTMPI on Ethereum can be bridged to the native Neutaro chain via OraiDEX for staking and governance participation.

⟁ Bridging to Neutaro

The swap widget delivers ERC-20 NTMPI on Ethereum. To use NTMPI for staking, governance, or node operations, bridge your tokens to the native Neutaro chain:

  1. Go to OraiDEX Bridge
  2. Connect your Ethereum wallet and Keplr/OWallet
  3. Bridge NTMPI from Ethereum → Oraichain → Neutaro
  4. Delegate to validators in the Neutaro Explorer
